import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('dataset.csv')

# Fill missing 'Sleep Disorder' with 'None'
data['Sleep Disorder'] = data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create subplots
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Sleep Duration vs Daily Steps
plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
sns.scatterplot(x='Daily Steps', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Sleep Disorder', size='Age', data=data)
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Daily Steps')

# BMI Category Distribution
plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
sns.countplot(x='BMI Category', data=data, palette='Set2')
plt.title('BMI Category Distribution')

# Sleep Quality vs Stress Level
plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
sns.barplot(x='Stress Level', y='Quality of Sleep', data=data, ci=None)
plt.title('Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level')

# Average Sleep Duration by Occupation
plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
sns.barplot(x='Occupation', y='Sleep Duration', data=data, ci=None, estimator=np.mean)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()
